headlines.text: 2022 brought us this moment: the AEW TNT Title was up for grabs as Sammy Guevara vs. Isiah Kassidy went to war, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.10. For Isiah Kassidy, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. This stood as the 40th match in AEW TNT Title history ? a significant milestone for the title. A sneaky-good performance from Kassidy, whose ribs-taped opponent had to grind out a hard-fought retention ? capped by an intriguing post-match face-off with Darby Allin, eyeing the TNT Title for himself.
